# Establishments flagged as outpatient-reporting

**112 establishments** (85 hospitals and 27 nursing posts). Generated by `tools/build_establishments_doc.mjs` from `data/reference/establishments.json`. Retrieved 2026-10-27.

## What this list is, and is not

* It is the set of sites that the Department of Health spatial dataset **HEALTH-001 "Health Hospitals"** flags **"Outpatient Reporting" = Y** (SLIP public service, layers 7 and 6).
* It is **not** a certified list of NADC reporting establishments. The official Establishments list PDF could not be retrieved, and HEALTH-001 does not define the flag. Whether it means "reports to the Non-Admitted Data Collection" is the first open question in [OPEN-QUESTIONS.md](OPEN-QUESTIONS.md).
* **Code** is the HEALTH-001 `estab_id` padded to four digits. That it equals the NADC *Establishment Code* is an assumption (see [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md) 4.1).
* **HSP** (Health Service Provider) comes from HEALTH-001's geographic service, with the overrides in the notes below (checked against the Department of Health Central Referral Service page, last reviewed 8 Sep 2026, and the cited sources).
* **Region and district** are the HEALTH-001 / HEALTH-002 assignments. For example, the "City" district is in East Metro and "Lower West" (which contains Sir Charles Gairdner Hospital) is in North Metro. This follows SLIP and may differ from the HSP catchment a clinician would name.
* **Lat/long** are the HEALTH-001 coordinates (decimal degrees; the datum is not stated in the layer description).
* **Beds** are HEALTH-001 "No. of beds" (0 means not recorded, for example Hedland). For the synthetic volumes only, a regional-category site with no bed count is sized as if it had 60 beds (a modelling assumption, not a fact about Hedland).
* **Contracted** marks sites run by a non-government operator on behalf of the State.
* All data: © Government of Western Australia, Department of Health, via SLIP / data.wa.gov.au (HEALTH-001). Licence listed as "Not specified" on the catalogue.

## Sites needing a note

* **0107 Perth Children's Hospital** (CAHS): Perth Children's Hospital is part of CAHS (DoH CRS page, 8 Sep 2026; SLIP lists it under the North Metro geographic service).
* **0612 St John of God Bunbury Hospital** (WACHS): Private hospital (St John of God Health Care) in the WACHS South West area; HEALTH-001 flags outpatient reporting. Contract detail not verified.
* **0629 St John of God Mt Lawley Hospital** (EMHS): Mount Lawley Hospital: purchased from St John of God Health Care by the WA Government, transferring to State ownership on 31 Aug 2026 (WA Government media statement, 1 May 2026); listed on the EMHS website (26 Oct 2026). HEALTH-001 still lists it as Private under code 645. Search summaries of the May 2026 Establishments list say the public code is 145 (645 an older or private-era code); not verified, so the SLIP code is kept.
* **0642 Joondalup Health Campus** (NMHS): Joondalup Health Campus is operated by Ramsay Health Care under a public-private arrangement; listed under NMHS on the DoH CRS page. HEALTH-001 lists it as Private.
* **0645 Peel Health Campus** (SMHS): Peel Health Campus returned to public hands (SMHS) on 13 Aug 2024; listed under SMHS on the DoH CRS page. HEALTH-001 still lists it as Private under code 645. Search summaries of the May 2026 Establishments list say the public code is 145 (645 an older or private-era code); not verified, so the SLIP code is kept.
* **6007 St John of God Midland Hospital** (EMHS): St John of God Midland Public Hospital is operated by St John of God Health Care under a public-private arrangement; listed under EMHS (EMHS website and DoH CRS page). HEALTH-001 lists it as Private.

## Known gaps

* Sites that may report to the NADC but are not flagged in HEALTH-001 (for example Child and Adolescent Health Service community sites, Graylands, Selby, Next Step, and the Byford Health Hub that the EMHS website lists) are **not** in this list. Whether they report is an open question.
* The site list reflects HEALTH-001 as retrieved on 2026-10-27. The Department's own current Establishments list should replace it.
* A Women, Babies and Children HSP is planned from July 2027 (one source, medium confidence). It is not modelled.
